annotations.title: Mark a launch or other event

description: Adds an event to the connected workspace (a launch, press, a newsletter, an ad push, a promotion or something else) for one day or a date range in the workspace's time zone, so sales around it aren't credited to creators in the next report. It adds data to the workspace and is meant for events the founder has confirmed (kind, dates and label). Needs the founder to have allowed marking events when connecting.

first_day.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, workspace time zone.

label.description: A short note, e.g. 'Product Hunt launch'.

last_day.description: Last day (inclusive). Leave out for one day.
